priorityList: Cast Kill Shot if Death Blow is active or the target is below 20% health.
Cast Wildfire Bomb if you are about to reach 2 charges to avoid over-capping.
Cast Kill Command to generate Focus and Tip of the Spear stacks, ensuring you do not over-cap either resource.
Maintain a cadence of using two abilities between each use of Kill Command to optimize Tip of the Spear and Focus generation.
Cast Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) to spend Focus and consume Tip of the Spear stacks, maximizing uses to trigger Apex procs.
Cast Flanking Strike if you require immediate Focus generation.
Cast Fury of the Eagle when at 3 stacks of Tip of the Spear.
